name: QA Daily Report Generator | Portfolio Template

parameters.formDescription: Fill only the activities that Jira cannot know.

values.placeholder:
Examples:

• API validation using Postman
• Database validation
• SQL data verification
• Mobile application exploratory testing
• Mobile application regression testing
• Production issue verification
• Performance testing using JMeter
• Playwright automation development
• Cross-device testing
• Cross-browser testing

Leave blank if there are no additional activities.

Describe any blockers preventing QA testing.

Leave blank if there are no blockers.

Example:

Continue testing pending development tickets.
Retest resolved issues.
Complete remaining QA verification.

assignments.name: jql
assignments.value:
(
    created >= startOfDay()
    AND created < endOfDay()
    AND creator = currentUser()
)
OR
(
    status CHANGED BY currentUser()
    FROM "IN QA"
    TO "Resolved"
    AFTER startOfDay()
    BEFORE endOfDay()
)
OR
(
    status CHANGED BY currentUser()
    FROM "IN QA"
    TO "Re open"
    AFTER startOfDay()
    BEFORE endOfDay()
)
ORDER BY created DESC, status DESC, updated DESC
